history.text: A Merpati Nusantara Airlines Vickers Viscount crashes into the Indian Ocean near Padang, West Sumatra, Indonesia, killing all 69 people on board.
history.title: Merpati Nusantara Airlines

photo.title: File:Verdun – Cathédrale Notre-Dame – Crypte 2025 08 16.jpg
photo.caption: 12th-century crypt of Verdun Cathedral, France, rediscovered after the Great War during the restoration works. When the reconstruction of the crypt was completed, the cathedral was reconsecrated on 10 November 1935.
photo.creator: Andreas F. Borchert

culture.text: National Educational Television (the predecessor to the Public Broadcasting Service) in the United States debuts Sesame Street.
culture.title: National Educational Television
